assetManifestFormat: SHA256 + two spaces + relative path + LF, sorted by path
producer: Reto Stöckli, NASA Earth Observatory (NASA Goddard Space Flight Center)

source.title: Blue Marble: Next Generation, July 2004, Base Map with Topography

usage.description: NASA imagery used for informational geographic context, with attribution; no NASA insignia or endorsement. Third-party assets are not included.

limitations.en: Historical monthly satellite composite with topographic shading. A global overview, not current imagery, street-level detail or a navigation map. No administrative boundary overlay.
limitations.zh: 历史月度卫星合成影像，含地形明暗。用于全球概览，不代表实时影像、街道级细节或导航地图；未叠加行政边界。

processing.resampling: Lanczos; source to z4, then successive 2x reductions; globe directly from source
